desc: Ideation: decide on next-greater + binary lifting approach.
Compute per-index segment cost (deficit to raise up to current value until next greater) and prefix sums.
Implement `get_cost(l, r)` using binary lifting to handle full segments and partial tail.
For each left endpoint `l`, binary search the maximal `r` with `get_cost(l, r) ≤ k`, accumulate `r - l + 1`.
